verified: pc-exile-play-2 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rules cited (sta.pcep2.firstSpell.cascade): the first spell its controller casts each turn (the caster's own count, a copy never counts) has cascade as it is cast, so the cascade trigger happens (CR 601.2i, 702.85a, 613.1f).

pc-exile-play-2 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rules cited (sta.pcep2.firstSpell.fromZone.cascade): the first spell its controller casts from exile each turn has cascade; a spell cast from another zone before it does not use it up (CR 601.2i, 702.85a, 613.1f).

pc-exile-play-2 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rules cited (eff.stdrs.player.exileUntil, eff.r3cost.cast.anyNumber.free.fromAmong; the Them reading 'those nonland cards'): each opponent exiles cards until a nonland card and you may cast any number of the spells among those cards free (CR 608.2g, 118.9, 305.9).
